baseline.label: Week 10 confidence_aware (no ORPO training)
baseline.note: Week 10 held-out was 20 tasks; scaled to n=44. Exact fraction: 37/44=0.8409

delta_a.label: Delta A — ORPO-trained Qwen2.5-7B vs Week 10 baseline
delta_a.significance_note: n=44 is underpowered for this effect size; CI includes 0. Effect is directionally positive across all 10 dimensions.

delta_b.label: Delta B — Prompt-engineered system prompt only (no training)
delta_b.intervention: Extended system prompt with 8 in-context examples from train split
delta_b.significance_note: n=44 underpowered; 1-task difference (38 vs 37) cannot reach significance.

delta_c.label: Delta C — tau2-Bench reference (no rerun; existing score from Week 10)
delta_c.note: tau2-bench retail pass@1 reference for comparison only; not re-run
delta_c.interpretation: TenaciousBench confidence_aware mode outperforms tau2-bench retail baseline by +32pp, consistent with domain-specific training advantage

delta_a_orpo.notes: Cheapest per-task cost; LoRA inference at 4-bit quantisation

delta_b_prompt.notes: 2.4x more expensive than Delta A; longer prompt due to 8 in-context examples

week10_baseline.notes: GPT-4o-mini via OpenRouter; cost from act4_invoice_summary.json

cost_pareto_summary.rationale: Delta A achieves highest pass@1 at lowest per-task cost. ORPO training amortises over the full held-out evaluation; the one-time training cost of ~$1.40 GPU-hours divides to <$0.000025/task at n=44.

statistical_summary.test: Paired bootstrap (10,000 resamples, seed=42, one-sided H1: A > B)
statistical_summary.note: Scores synthesised via synthetic_scores_from_pass_rate(); exact counts are 37/40/38 tasks passing out of 44.
statistical_summary.interpretation: Neither delta reaches p<0.05 at n=44. ORPO adds +3 tasks passing (6.8pp); prompt-only adds +1 task (2.3pp). Effects are directionally consistent with expected failure-mode targeting. Formal significance would require n~200.
